statement: A top-5 developer reports AI systems did >= 50% of code or experiments in a frontier training project (technical report or system card; by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Company-wide code share already well above 50% at two top-5 Bloc A developers (>80% of merged code at one as of May 2026; 'majority' / >75% of production code at another), but no report yet scopes the figure to a specific frontier training project, and experiments remain human-directed. Likely resolves YES on a liberal reading; strict reading requires project-level attribution.

items.summary: A top-5 Bloc A developer reported that its engineers' average code output per quarter is about 8x the 2021-2025 level, attributing the rise to its own models, and called for a verifiable option to pause frontier development.
items.detail: Anthropic Institute, 'When AI builds itself' (Favaro & Clark, 2026-06-04; updated 2026-09-18). Leadership separately estimated >=90% incl. scripts/experimental code. Figure is company-wide, not a single training project.

items.summary: Update to the same essay: the developer's models now lead ~26% of its R&D tasks end-to-end from a high-level prompt under human supervision - i.e. experiments are still mostly human-led.
items.detail: Anthropic essay update 2026-09-18, as reported by LA Times / Bloc A Times 2026-09-19 (via you.com summary).

items.summary: Another top-5 Bloc A developer said it reached its goal of an 'automated research intern' (well-defined multi-day research tasks under human direction); experiments per researcher hit an all-time high in Aug 2026; targets an automated AI researcher by March 2028. No code or experiment share published.
items.detail: OpenAI, 'Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI' (2026-09-06).

items.summary: A third top-5 Bloc A developer's frontier safety report stated AI agents 'author a majority of production code' at its AI lab and that most production code is over 75% AI-written; some internal agents run with the host user's full privileges.
items.detail: Google DeepMind Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report, quoted by The Midas Project Watchtower 2026-10-13.

items.summary: Independent evaluator found AI cannot yet fully automate substantial parts of a top-5 developer's model training pipeline, while ~80% of a ~1.9x capability-progress acceleration is likely due to AI used in R&D.
items.detail: METR, 'Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026'.

items.summary: In its IPO filing the first developer said it does not expect to safely let its model fully build its successors without meaningful human supervision and is weighing human-review requirements for certain research decisions.
items.detail: Anthropic S-1/A No. 2 (2026-11-10), per The Next Web 2026-11-12.
